questions.stem: What is the correct pathway of information through the nervous system when responding to a stimulus?

options.text: Effector, motor neurone, relay neurone, sensory neurone, receptor
Receptor, motor neurone, relay neurone, sensory neurone, effector
Receptor, sensory neurone, relay neurone, motor neurone, effector
Stimulus, effector, relay neurone, receptor, response

questions.explanation: The correct pathway is: receptor detects stimulus, sensory neurone carries impulse to CNS, relay neurone processes in CNS, motor neurone carries impulse to effector, which produces a response.
